card: Enables CMake policies CMP0156 and CMP0179 on CMake >= 3.31 to de-duplicate libraries on link lines, and configures macOS Guix builds to treat linker warnings as fatal errors with -Wl,-fatal_warnings. This silences Apple linker warnings regarding duplicate libraries and brings macOS Guix builds in line with other target platforms that already fail on linker warnings. For environments using CMake versions older than 3.31, the policy guard makes the change a no-op.
evidence: Author description states this "silences Apple linker 'ignoring duplicate libraries' warnings"
Author description notes the Guix change aligns macOS with other platforms: "The Guix scripts for macOS have been updated to turn linker warnings into errors, as is done for other targets."
problem: Apple's linker issues warnings when duplicate libraries appear on link lines. Additionally, macOS Guix build scripts did not treat linker warnings as fatal errors, unlike builds for other target platforms.
summary: Enables CMake policies CMP0156 and CMP0179 when CMake >= 3.31 is present to de-duplicate libraries on link lines while preserving the first occurrence of static libraries. In addition, updates the macOS Guix build scripts to treat linker warnings as fatal errors.
